name: next-with-text
description: One-line llms.txt, llms-full.txt, and per-page markdown for Next.js

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.cjs --packages=external && bun build src/adapter.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/adapter.cjs --packages=external && bun build src/patch.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/patch.cjs --external=@xberg-io/html-to-markdown && bun build src/route.ts --target=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/route.js --external=@xberg-io/html-to-markdown && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && mv dist/index.d.ts dist/index.d.cts
scripts.test: bun run build && tsc --noEmit && bun test
